user.title: Wiener Linien
user.description: Real-time departures for Vienna's public transport. Departure monitors are added afterwards via “Add departure monitor”. Data is only fetched while a dashboard card is visible.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Wiener Linien is already set up.

direction.title: Destination
direction.description: Which destination should be shown at {stop} (line {line})? The choice also selects the correct platform. Vehicles going somewhere else are highlighted.

manual.title: Enter IDs manually
manual.description: Find IDs with the [mabe.at helper](https://till.mabe.at/rbl/). The stop ID is the RBL number. {lines}

data_description.stop_id: RBL number of the platform, e.g. 391.
data_description.line_id: Numeric line id, e.g. 105 for line 5. Leave empty if only one line serves this stop.
data_description.towards: Vehicles whose destination does not start with this text are highlighted. Leave empty to disable.
Vehicles whose destination does not start with this text are highlighted. Leave empty to disable.

error.catalog_unavailable: The open data lists could not be loaded. Enter the IDs manually.
error.stop_not_found: No departures found for this stop ID.
error.line_not_found: This line does not serve the stop. Found: {lines}
error.line_required: Several lines serve this stop, please enter the line ID: {lines}
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Wiener Linien API.
error.api_error: The Wiener Linien API returned an error.

data_description.update_interval: How often the Wiener Linien API is queried while a dashboard card is visible. Minimum 15 s; the API allows about 10 requests per 30 s.
